purpose: Text-free production artwork for Sun of Korea component kit

prompts.name: dawn-desktop
prompts.prompt: Generate production WEBSITE BACKGROUND ART ONLY, no UI, NO TEXT, no letters, numbers, signage, logos, labels, buttons, cards, people portraits or watermark. Wide landscape 2560x1440. Reference is approved website concept: reproduce the exquisite cinematic HD-2D pixel-art Seoul sunrise setting but REMOVE ALL typography, navigation, buttons, portrait/photo, section below. This is an original full-scene illustration to sit UNDER real HTML. Top and LEFT 52% of canvas must be quiet pale warm cream-peach open sky, very low detail, usable for dark HTML heading at x6%-48%, y20%-55%. Right 48%: softly glowing natural sun at x78%, y33% above Namsan hill and recognizable N Seoul Tower; layered Korean mountain silhouettes, Seoul urban cityscape, Han River luminous sunrise reflection. Not the Great Wall. Bottom 30%: gorgeous detailed pixel-art riverside campus neighborhood, traditional Korean roofs, trees, cherry blossoms, cobblestone walkway. Diverse small student characters study together at a table at x40%, y85%; another helps a newcomer with a map; small maker's window at lower left with blank screen and warm lamp; a pair talking on bench at right. No visible written signs or words anywhere. Soft golden sunlight travels through inhabited landscape, warmth and generosity, professional pixel artistry with realistic atmospheric depth and intentional light. Palette cream #FFF7E6, sunshine #FFD859, peach coral, cool blue shadows, green vegetation. Preserve hopeful cinematic framing. NO dark luxury style, NO boxed panels, no viewport frame. Full bleed landscape artwork with clean readable left sky.

prompts.name: world-atlas
prompts.prompt: Generate production WEBSITE INTERACTIVE MAP BACKGROUND ART ONLY, no UI, absolutely NO TEXT, letters, numbers, signage, logos, labels, speech bubbles or watermark. Landscape 1920x1280. Use approved concept reference for art direction only; REMOVE header, text, left copy, portrait, buttons and lower section. Fill entire canvas with exquisite sophisticated isometric HD-2D pixel-art world on warm cream #FFF7E6. Terrain is a connected Korean campus neighborhood, five DISTINCT places arranged to support five real HTML hotspot buttons: top-left (x23%,y29%) a glass and redbrick chemical engineering laboratory with blue-lit equipment, piping, flask; top-right (x76%,y28%) a mint-accented international language exchange terrace with diverse students sharing books; lower-left (x22%,y66%) an open purple-accented software maker workshop with desk and screens; right-lower (x78%,y68%) coral-accented community courtyard with people cooperating and setting up a shared event; bottom-center (x48%,y85%) a sunshine-accented library/scholar reading garden. Center x50%,y46% open common square containing warm stylized SUN BEACON that lights paths for everyone, not metallic sci-fi, not a throne or temple. Meandering paths physically connect all five places, stream and small bridges, cherry blossoms, vegetation, visible small welcoming human characters. Seoul skyline and mountains only in distant upper edge. Map edges softly blend into cream background without hard rectangle edge. Leave small visually quiet areas just above each building for HTML labels added separately. Balanced spacious geography, no overlapping areas, no enormous unrelated landmarks. High quality pixel craft and cinematic morning lighting, mature welcoming playful world. Whole canvas is artwork, no website UI at all.

prompts.name: dawn-mobile
prompts.prompt: Generate production MOBILE WEBSITE BACKGROUND ART ONLY, no UI, absolutely NO TEXT, letters, signs, logos, buttons, portrait photo, or watermark. Portrait 1024x1536. Translate approved concept's pixel-art Seoul sunrise into an intentionally composed tall mobile scene. TOP 55% should be a quiet pale cream and peach open dawn sky to support real black HTML headings and buttons; a few sparse soft pixel clouds at very edges only, no sun behind left-center text. Natural golden sun at x80%, y53% above Seoul Namsan hill and N Seoul Tower at x84%,y60%. Lower 45% features atmospheric Korean mountain layers, Seoul skyline, Han River glowing reflections, foreground Korean roofs, pink blossoms and trees. Bottom 20% welcoming diverse tiny students around a shared outdoor table, one person giving directions to another, warm lamp in maker's window. Exquisite HD-2D pixel-art craft, cinematic atmospheric lighting and depth, hopeful sunlight, cream #FFF7E6 and sunshine #FFD859 with cool-blue shadows, natural greenery and coral flowers. Whole portrait artwork, no inset cards or white footer. Do not blindly crop desktop; give foreground people breathing room and reserve top half for content.
